channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PT pede que Flávio seja multado por fala sobre urnas eletrônicas
item.description: The PT has asked the TSE to fine Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, Gustavo Gayer, and Júlia Zanatta R$30,000 each for spreading disinformation about electronic voting machines, falsely claiming Brazil uses equipment from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic. The party alleges these statements are part of a coordinated effort to undermine confidence in the electoral system and requests the removal of posts distorting a CIA report on Venezuela’s voting system.

item.title: Equipe de Lula se divide sobre ida a debates em 2026
item.description: Lula's campaign team is divided over his participation in the 2026 presidential debates, with no consensus reached, as he will ultimately decide. He will skip the first debate on August 16 at 8 p.m. on Band due to a campaign rally in São Bernardo do Campo at 10 a.m. the same day, at the venue where he began his union activism in the late 1970s. The strategy favors rallies with allies and grassroots campaigning, echoing 2006 when Lula avoided first-round debates due to overconfidence — a miscalculation that remains a political trauma.

item.title: “A diferença do Flávio para a Viviane Barci é apenas o valor do contrato”
item.description: Renan Santos, president of Missão, stated that the difference between Viviane Barci de Moraes, wife of Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is 'only the value' of their contract with Banco Master. The comment followed a Metrópoles report on the involved law firm.

item.title: PP evita aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro para eleição
item.description: Ciro Nogueira, national president of the Progressistas (PP), rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) request for a presidential coalition during a meeting in Brasília on Wednesday (22). Although the meeting took place, Ciro avoided publicly commenting on its content, maintaining the party's neutral stance. The decision reinforces PP's strategy of avoiding alignment with Bolsonarist candidates for the 2026 election.

item.title: A contenção dos Bolsonaros
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, repeated his father’s false claims about electronic voting machines during a meeting with ambassadors, sparking negative backlash. Although he attempted to soften the statement, the damage was already done, reinforcing election denial narratives. Folha de S.P. headline described the act as surgically spreading disinformation.

item.title: PT pede que TSE multe Flávio Bolsonaro por fala sobre urnas eletrônicas e retire post de Eduardo e aliados
item.description: The PT has asked the TSE to fine Flávio Bolsonaro R$30,000 for spreading disinformation about electronic voting machines, falsely claiming they originate from Smartmatic and are linked to Venezuelan fraud. The party also seeks the removal of posts by Eduardo Bolsonaro, Gustavo Gayer, and Júlia Zanatta questioning the electoral system, along with similar fines for them. The PT argues the CIA document cited makes no reference to Brazil and its use is a deliberate distortion to undermine trust in the electoral process.

item.title: Paulo Figueiredo diz que declaração de Bolsonaro à Maria do Rosário sobre estupro foi ‘genial’
item.description: Bolsonarista influencer Paulo Figueiredo, grandson of former dictator João Figueiredo, praised Jair Bolsonaro's 2014 statement that Maria do Rosário 'did not deserve to be raped', calling it 'genial' because 'everyone thought so'. He also mocked deputy Jandira Feghali, suggesting rape threats against her were akin to suicide threats due to her appearance. Figueiredo is under investigation by the STF for alleged involvement in the 2022 election coup attempt.

item.title: PT aciona o TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro por fake news sobre as urnas
item.description: The PT-led federation (PT, PCdoB, PV) filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO), and deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) for spreading false claims that Brazilian electronic voting machines originate from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, allegedly involved in electoral fraud. The parties seek a R$30,000 fine for each, immediate removal of social media posts, a ban on repeating the allegations, and notification to digital platforms to block content linking Smartmatic to Brazil’s electoral system. TSE President Minister Nunes Marques was randomly assigned as the case rapporteur.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro por dados falsos sobre urnas e cita precedentes de Francischini e Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, and PCdoB) filed a representation with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and allies for spreading false information about Brazilian electronic voting machines, falsely linking them to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic based on a declassified CIA report about Venezuela. The action references prior sanctions against Francischini and Jair Bolsonaro for electoral disinformation and urges the TSE to recognize the conduct as an electoral crime and apply legal penalties.

item.title: Governo discute novas medidas aos setores afetados por tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government announced extra credit for companies affected by the 25% tariff imposed by the United States and is discussing additional measures to alleviate impacts on affected sectors. The initiative aims to mitigate the effects of the U.S. tariff on the Brazilian economy, particularly in export-dependent industries. Measures are under internal review and expected to be announced soon.

item.title: Crusoé: PT surfa em tarifaço e lança campanha “O Brasil não se entrega”
item.description: The PT launched the campaign 'Brazil does not surrender' on the same day the US tariff on Brazilian imports took effect, linking the measure to the Bolsonaro family and framing it as a defense of national sovereignty. The initiative seeks to leverage the trade context to reinforce a narrative of resistance against external policies perceived as harmful to the country.

item.title: Flávio emitiu notas fiscais para cobrar de empresas ligadas a Vorcaro
item.description: The law office of Flávio Bolsonaro issued three invoices of R$ 500,000 each to companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro's scheme, totaling R$ 1.5 million. Two invoices were canceled, but one remains active, tied to legal services for Contábil Correa. Flávio denies wrongdoing, stating the services were not rendered and that canceled invoices reflect this, while alleging illegal leaks of confidential information by government entities.

item.title: Arthur Lira diz que PP pode ter nome próprio ao governo de AL
item.description: Federal deputy and Senate pre-candidate Arthur Lira (PP-AL) stated that the União Progressista federation (Progressistas and União Brasil) may launch its own candidate for the Alagoas governorship if an alliance with former Maceió mayor João Henrique Caldas (JHC) fails to materialize. He emphasized that waiting for JHC’s decision remains the priority, but if no agreement is reached, the bloc will pursue a standalone candidacy to solidify its political positioning. Party conventions began on July 20 and must conclude by August 5.

item.title: Escritório de Flávio Bolsonaro foi contratado por empresa ligada a consultoria que recebeu repasses do Master, mostram documentos
item.description: The law office of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received R$ 500,000 from Contábil Correa for legal advisory services, according to an April 2025 invoice. The accounting firm is linked to Copenhagen, a consultancy that received R$ 57.9 million from Banco Master between 2024 and 2025. Flávio denies wrongdoing, stating the relationship is legal and private, and that he canceled two invoices totaling R$ 1 million issued to Copenhagen.

item.title: Flávio reage à publicação de notas emitidas para empresas ligadas a Vorcaro: "Completamente legal e privado"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied working for Copenhagen Consultancy, a firm linked to Daniel Vorcaro, stating that the issuance of invoices was legal and private. He acknowledged issuing three invoices in April 2025 — two for R$500,000 each to Copenhagen (later canceled) and one to Contábil Correa, whose partner is a Copenhagen director — without explaining why he issued them if he did not render services. The case raises suspicions of using invoices to move funds tied to Banco Master.

item.title: Declaração de Flávio Bolsonaro contra as urnas chega ao TSE
item.description: The TSE will analyze Flávio Bolsonaro's statements against electronic voting machines made to ambassadors, following a lawyer's petition questioning whether such statements constitute an implicit renunciation of his right to run for office. The Court has already denied the claim that Brazil purchased Smartmatic voting machines, and Minister Floriano Azevedo is the rapporteur. The PT is also considering legal action against the senator.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro emitiu e cancelou R$ 1 milhão em notas fiscais para empresa que operou com o Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) issued and canceled two invoices of R$ 500 thousand each, totaling R$ 1 million, for a company that received R$ 5.9 million from Banco Master. The invoices were canceled after issuance, raising concerns about potential financial irregularities.

item.title: China diz a governo Lula que apoia Brasil na defesa da soberania
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi reaffirmed China's support for Brazil's sovereignty during an ASEAN meeting in the Philippines, emphasizing the strategic partnership and advocating for cooperation in finance, trade, technology, aerospace, and AI. Brazilian Chancellor Mauro Vieira called for deeper economic ties with China, while the PT launched a national campaign defending national sovereignty, including Pix, domestic industry, rare earths, and opposition to the new 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Em encontro com Lula, Stellantis detalha investimento de R$ 30 bilhões no Brasil
item.description: Stellantis announced a R$ 30 billion investment in Brazil between 2025 and 2030 during a meeting with President Lula in Brasília. The plan includes expanding production, launching new models such as the Jeep Avenger, adopting new technology, adding shifts at the Betim and Rio de Janeiro plants, and creating 2,000 direct jobs, with an estimated 20,000 indirect jobs in the supply chain. The company noted that 95% of its components are sourced locally, amounting to R$ 60 billion annually in purchases from Brazilian suppliers.

item.title: Ministros do STF cobram resposta mais dura do TSE sobre urnas
item.description: Supreme Court ministers expressed discomfort over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) statements questioning the reliability of electronic voting machines, labeling the episode as serious and demanding a stronger stance from the Superior Electoral Court. Despite their concern, the justices noted that the situation differs from previous cases involving challenges to the electoral system.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil continuará negociando com os EUA, mas buscará por novos mercados
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will continue negotiating with the U.S. over the 25% tariff but will not 'cry' over lost sales, instead seeking new markets for its products. He announced a new phase of the Plano Brasil Soberano, allocating R$ 18.5 billion in financing for companies affected by U.S. tariffs, targeting strategic sectors such as fertilizers, critical minerals, and pharmaceuticals. The government emphasized that the crisis does not hinder Brazil’s economic growth trajectory.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil não sairá da mesa de negociação sobre tarifaço
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will not walk away from the negotiation table with the United States over the 25% tariffs imposed as of July 22, 2026, despite the lack of reciprocity in talks. He said Brazil will seek other buyers and emphasized that the Plano Brasil Soberano, with R$18.5 billion in credit, will be expanded via a provisional measure to support companies affected by the tariffs and international trade conflicts.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral pelo Brasil: TREs se mobilizam para as eleições de outubro
item.description: The Electoral Justice intensifies preparations for the October 2026 elections across Brazil. In Tocantins, electoral court staff are undergoing advanced training on electoral systems and disinformation, while in Mato Grosso, polling stations — mainly schools — are being inspected to ensure readiness for voters.

item.title: Crise na Nicarágua e declaração de Ortega inflamam debate político nas redes, aponta levantamento
item.description: Statements by Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega, claiming there will be no more elections to prevent the opposition from taking power, sparked intense debate on Brazilian social media, with over 675,000 interactions in 24 hours across X, Instagram, and Facebook. The topic reached 7th place in Brazil’s X Trending Topics, and Ortega was searched over 50,000 times on Google Trends Brazil, with opposition figures linking him to President Lula to demand stronger stances, while government supporters emphasized Itamaraty’s diplomatic approach toward authoritarian regimes.

item.title: Ala do PSDB articula candidatura própria em SP
item.description: A São Paulo wing of the PSDB is articulating an independent candidacy for former senator José Aníbal in the 2026 gubernatorial race, defying the party’s national directive to support Tarcísio de Freitas’ (Republicanos) re-election. The effort is led by long-standing party figures seeking an alternative to the current governor.

item.title: Não vamos sair da mesa de negociação, diz Lula sobre tarifaço de Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil will not withdraw from negotiations with the United States regarding tariffs imposed by the Trump administration on Brazilian products. He emphasized the importance of dialogue to resolve trade disputes and protect national interests.

item.title: Ministros do STF veem fala de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre urnas como grave e defendem resposta do TSE
item.description: STF ministers labeled Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s remarks questioning the security of electronic voting machines as grave, noting distinctions from the case that led to Jair Bolsonaro’s ineligibility but stressing the need for the TSE to issue a clearer defense of electoral integrity. They criticized the TSE’s current response — merely reissuing a 2020 note — as insufficient and urged a stronger public stance against misinformation, particularly regarding false claims about Smartmatic’s involvement in Brazil’s voting system.

item.title: PP e União Brasil decidem manter neutralidade sobre apoio a Flávio
item.description: The União Progressista federation, formed by Brazil Union and Progressistas, has decided to maintain neutrality regarding support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in his pre-candidacy for the Presidency of the Republic, allowing its state directories to define positions autonomously. While the São Paulo section has already declared support for Bolsonaro, PP senators met with the party's national president, Ciro Nogueira, in Brasília to discuss the matter, whose final stance remains to be formalized by the federation's leadership.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebeu R$ 500 mil de diretor de empresa do esquema do Banco Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received R$ 500,000 from Contabil Correa Contabilidade & Auditoria LTDA in April 2025 for legal advisory services, as confirmed by a fiscal note. The company’s administrator, Rogério Lourenço Novo, is also a director of Copenhagen and Assessoria, linked to the Banco Master scheme involving Daniel Vorcaro. Bolsonaro stated the work was legal and private, though he rejected two additional R$ 500,000 payments from Copenhagen, whose invoices were later canceled.

item.title: Cotado para a vice de Zema, empresário anuncia pré-candidatura ao Senado pelo Podemos de SP
item.description: Businessman Geraldo Rufino announced his pre-candidacy for the Senate in São Paulo under the Podemos party, after being considered as a potential running mate for former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo). Zema had cited Rufino as a candidate due to shared Minas roots, but Rufino chose to run for Senate instead. Zema also briefly mentioned Michelle Bolsonaro as a possible vice-presidential pick, but denied extending an invitation after she publicly rejected the idea.

item.title: Centrão não sente em Flávio Bolsonaro o aroma do poder
item.description: Despite having an ascending candidacy in February, Flávio Bolsonaro failed to consolidate political support by the eve of the convention that would formalize his presidential bid. He has yet to name a running mate or form a coalition, revealing weakness in his political maneuvering within the Centrão and difficulty securing strategic alliances. The absence of key political arrangements suggests his presidential project lacks the 'scent of power' needed to advance strongly in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Renan Santos critica falas de Flávio sobre urnas: “Vergonha”
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL–RJ) claims about vulnerabilities in Brazil’s electronic voting machines, calling them an 'international embarrassment' and suggesting they may constitute political self-sabotage. Renan acknowledged that while Brazil’s electoral system could be improved, it remains functional, democratic, and a potential model for other nations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro nega irregularidades de seu escritório com empresa ligada a Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied that his law office issued R$1.5 million in invoices to companies linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro, and stated he did not receive funds from Copenhagen Consultoria e Assessoria S.A.

item.title: Brasil pediu aos EUA que sobretaxa de 12,5% não seja cumulativa
item.description: The Lula government asked the U.S. to ensure that a proposed 12.5% tariff on Brazilian goods over alleged forced labor is not cumulative with existing duties, which could otherwise reach a total of 37.5%. Officials state the third edition of the Brazil Sovereign Plan, backed by R$18.5 billion, is sufficient to counter the impact and a fourth version is unnecessary. Negotiations with the U.S. continue, with a follow-up round expected after the USTR’s final tariff announcement this Friday (Jul 24).

item.title: Ala tucana se rebela contra apoio a Tarcísio e quer lançar Aníbal ao governo de SP
item.description: A historical faction of the São Paulo PSDB is articulating an independent candidacy for the state government, rejecting support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. The chosen name is former senator José Aníbal, positioning him as an alternative to the party’s current alignment. The move reflects internal divisions within the party over its political direction for 2026.

item.title: Moraes autoriza visita de Rogério Marinho a ex-comandante da Marinha na prisão
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized a visit by Senate opposition leader Rogério Marinho to imprisoned former Navy Commander Almir Garnier Santos. The request was made by the defense and granted by the minister.

item.title: Em plenária, centrais sindicais reforçam mobilização pelo fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Trade union centrals held a national virtual plenary to strengthen mobilization for ending the 6x1 work schedule and approving the PEC that reduces the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours, already passed by the Chamber and awaiting Senate vote. The union movement advocates dialogue with Congress, avoiding confrontation, and sees party conventions as opportunities to influence senators. The measure is backed by Lula as an electoral trump card and also by Chamber President Hugo Motta.

item.title: PT prepara ação na Justiça contra Flávio Bolsonaro por declarações sobre urnas a embaixadores
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) is preparing a legal action before the Electoral Justice against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for statements made to foreign ambassadors, in which he linked Brazil's electronic voting system to allegations of fraud in Venezuelan elections and claimed Brazilian machines originated from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic. The PT argues the claims are false and may constitute an electoral crime, as the TSE has repeatedly stated that Brazilian electronic voting machines are developed and operated solely by the Electoral Justice, with no ties to Smartmatic. The lawsuit is expected to be filed between Wednesday and Thursday.

item.title: Flávio faz vídeo de IA com versão criança e exibe faixa presidencial
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro posted an AI-generated video in which he dialogues with a child version of himself, asking whether he should continue trying in politics and receiving an affirmative response, ending with him wearing the presidential sash. The video mirrors a viral Neymar Jr. AI clip and continues the Bolsonaro family's trend of using AI for symbolic political storytelling.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: as múltiplas notas de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for presidency, had his law firm flagged for issuing invoices to companies linked to accountant Rogério Lourenço Novo, alleged operator of shell companies used by businessman Daniel Vorcaro to move funds from Banco Master. The allegations suggest possible use of corporate structures for illicit money laundering purposes.

item.title: TSE propõe 'Selo Maria Vai com as Urnas'
item.description: The TSE president proposes an 'electoral accuracy seal' in response to advocates of printed and auditable voting, linking the proposal to the January 8, 2023 movement. The author criticizes the initiative as a populist artifice that artificially breeds distrust in the popular vote, presenting it as a ruptural solution with the same genetic basis as election fraud allegations.

item.title: Irmão de Michelle ironiza: “Não se meta!”
item.description: Eduardo Torres, brother of Michelle Bolsonaro, defended his sister in an indirect response to former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, who criticized the release of a video in which Michelle disclosed tensions with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Torres replied sarcastically on social media with the phrase “Don’t interfere!”, without naming names directly. The post was published on O Antagonista.

item.title: Priscila Costa anuncia candidatura à Câmara
item.description: Deputy Priscila Costa (PL-CE), an ally of former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro, announced her candidacy for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies in 2026 following a meeting with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto. She stated that her Senate bid was harmed by Michelle Bolsonaro's departure from the presidency of PL Mulher.

item.title: Com voto de Mendonça, STF nega recurso da Universal e anula doação de fiel
item.description: The STF formed a majority to deny Universal's appeal and annul a believer's donation, upholding the TJ-MG ruling that classified the donations as resulting from irresistible moral coercion. The decisive vote came from Minister André Mendonça during the judicial recess, joining Fachin, Cármen Lúcia, Alexandre de Moraes, Cristiano Zanin and Dias Toffoli. The IURD was ordered to repay BRL 229,100 in donations, plus BRL 12,000 in moral damages, with interest and adjustment.

item.title: Caiado critica fala de Flávio Bolsonaro a embaixadores contra as urnas: 'Dava para atrair investimento'
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) remarks against electronic voting machines on social media, stating such comments deter investment and harm Brazil's image. He emphasized that trust in the electoral system is crucial for attracting foreign capital and maintaining institutional stability.

item.title: PT lança campanha ‘O Brasil não se entrega’ e associa família Bolsonaro ao tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The PT launched the campaign 'Brazil does not surrender' in response to U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, linking the Bolsonaro family to the measure and emphasizing economic harm to the country. The initiative supports Lula’s re-election, defending national sovereignty, jobs, and strategic sectors like PIX and rare earths. A poll shows 51% of Brazilians blame Lula for the tariffs and 30% blame Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting electoral polarization.

item.title: Lula cobra reciprocidade dos EUA e diz que Brasil não deixará mesa de negociação
item.description: President Lula criticized the lack of reciprocity in trade negotiations with the United States, stating Brazil made proposals and sought dialogue but faced American resistance despite facing 25% tariffs on Brazilian products. He announced R$15 billion from Brazil Soberano 2 and R$18.5 billion in credit for exporters, aiming to diversify markets and uphold national sovereignty amid the U.S. decision, which Brazil views as politically and ideologically motivated.

item.title: TSE pede que TREs firmem parcerias para fortalecer a análise técnica de casos de desinformação eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has directed regional electoral courts (TREs) to establish technical cooperation agreements with institutions specializing in artificial intelligence, digital forensics, and content analysis to strengthen the fight against electoral disinformation in the 2026 elections. The initiative aims to enhance the technical capacity of the Electoral Justice in producing evidence for cases involving disinformation and synthetic content, ensuring greater legal security in their analysis. The measure aligns with TSE Resolutions No. 23.610/2019 and 23.755/2026.

item.title: PP e União Brasil comunicam neutralidade a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Progressistas and União Brasil federation announced neutrality in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, undermining Flávio Bolsonaro’s efforts to form an alliance with the two parties. The decision, communicated by PP leader Senator Ciro Nogueira, applies to the first round and may extend to the second, stemming from deteriorating relations after Federal Police operations and lack of mutual support. The move also dampens hopes for Republican Party backing, which is likely to mirror the neutrality due to PL’s lack of support for its candidates in state races.

item.title: Apelação de Bolsonaro contra inelegibilidade pelo TSE segue parada na mesa de Fux
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's appeal against his ineligibility, imposed by the TSE in 2023 for political abuse of power and misuse of communication media, remains stalled in the rapporteurship of Minister Luiz Fux at the STF since March 2025. Even if the appeal were granted, Bolsonaro would remain ineligible due to another 2023 electoral conviction and, primarily, a 27-year-and-three-month prison sentence for leading a coup attempt, which, under the Clean Record Law, bars him from running for eight years after serving the sentence.
